correctness.rationale: For uniform-seed perfect-inoculation on labelled undirected C_n, individual susceptible cost equals Lg/n for its exposed component g, while a protected vertex becomes susceptible to merged component g_(i−1)+g_i+1 after deviation. The exact necessary/sufficient k>=2 gap constraints are 0<=g_i<=t, g_(i−1)+g_i+1>=t, Σg_i=n−k for t=nC/L; trace T(x)^k with T_uv=x^v 1{u+v+1>=t} counts cyclic gaps and n/k accounts for marked inoculated origin. k=0,1 exceptions correctly included at t>=n and n−1<=t<=n. For 2<t<3, no two adjacent susceptible runs survive cost-optimality; optimal vertex-cover inoculation k=ceil(n/2) gives Opt=(L/n)[n+(t−1)ceil(n/2)]. For k>=2 NE gap values 0,1,2 with b>=c; n−2k=b−c yields sharp odd/even BestNE gap (L/n)(3−t). Independently enumerated strategy, unilateral deviation and exact rational transfer for n=3..9, tie values; verified Perrin first cost cell. Finite data not a proof of all n.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge PASS for all-cost exact labelled-cycle Nash-spectrum transfer and sharp parity-sensitive social-optimum comparison. Aspnes–Chang–Yampolskiy already prove the general component threshold characterization; the present cycle-gap constraints specialize that prior theorem, and classical Perrin combinatorics is acknowledged. Full primary Aspnes and DiCicco et al. relevant treatments were examined; neither supplied the complete all-t labelled equilibrium polynomial plus exact 2<t<3 PoS parity formula.
